en.headline: Seven-year-old girl in critical condition with influenza A septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child with underlying illness developed symptoms on 29 October and remains critically ill at Tuen Mun Hospital after testing positive for influenza A (H1).
body: The Centre for Health Protection recorded a severe paediatric influenza case involving a seven-year-old girl with an underlying illness. She developed a runny nose, diarrhoea and abdominal pain on 29 October, then fever and a convulsion the following day.

She was taken to the Accident and Emergency Department at Tuen Mun Hospital and later transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit after her condition deteriorated. Her respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H1) virus. Doctors diagnosed influenza A infection complicated by septic shock. She remains in critical condition.

Preliminary investigation found the girl had no travel history during the incubation period and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. Household contacts have remained asymptomatic. Three classmates recently developed mild flu-like symptoms but did not require hospital admission.

Dr Edwin Tsui, Controller of the Centre for Health Protection, said Hong Kong has been in the influenza season since late June. Overall activity shows signs of decline but remains above baseline. This season has recorded 28 severe paediatric cases, with 20 children recovered and discharged, two stable, four critical and two deaths. The centre has advised the school to implement infection control measures and continues to investigate.

zh.headline: 7歲長期病患女童染甲流併發敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指女童10月29日起現病徵，在屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，呼吸道樣本對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日錄得一宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案，涉及一名有長期病患的七歲女童。她於10月29日出現流鼻水、腹瀉及腹痛，翌日出現發燒及抽搐。
女童被送到屯門醫院急症室求醫後入院，情況其後惡化，轉往該院兒童深切治療部接受治療。呼吸道樣本化驗後證實對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克。病人目前情況危殆。
中心初步調查顯示，女童於潛伏期內沒有外遊，尚未接種2026／27年度季節性流感疫苗。家居接觸者最近沒有病徵。就讀班別中另有三名同學近日出現輕微流感病徵，無需入院。中心已建議學校採取適當感染控制措施，並繼續調查個案。
中心總監徐樂堅醫生表示，香港自6月下旬進入流感季節至今已持續四個月，整體活躍程度雖有下降跡象但仍高於基線水平。本流感季節已錄得28宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，當中20宗已康復出院、兩宗情況穩定、四宗情況危殆及兩宗死亡。
